cards.name: Celebrity of Tsuganoki 2nd Middle School, Karen Araragi
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, choose one of your other 《Strange》 characters, and that character gets +1000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi
cards.text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.

【AUTO】 [(1)] When this card attacks, if a card named "Teeth Brushing Time" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, this card gets +3000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: A Morning Sight, Karen Araragi
cards.text: 【AUTO】 Change [(2) Put this card into your waiting room] At the beginning of your encore step, if this card is 【REST】, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "“Wreathe-fire Bee” Karen Araragi" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position this card was on.

cards.name: Mischievous Nature, Tsubasa Hanekawa
cards.text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.

cards.name: “Wreathe-fire Bee” Karen Araragi
cards.text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Strange》 characters you have is two or more, this card gets +1000 power.

【AUTO】 [Put a card from your hand into your waiting room] At the beginning of your opponent's attack phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your other characters and this card, exchange them as 【STAND】, and this card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Teeth Brushing Time
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.

cards.name: Smaller of the Sisters, Tsukihi Araragi
cards.text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card named "Brushing Teeth, Karen Araragi" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)
